body:
`task propose` waits for the human's answer with no time limit. Claude Code gives up on a tool call after 30 minutes of silence, and in task:0d391c4f357223b0 (run `a73df04d`) the calls after it, `task done` and `session remember`, then hung for 30 minutes each: 93 minutes in total.

Done when an agent waiting on `task propose` past Claude Code's limit doesn't leave its next calls hanging, and still gets the human's answer when it comes.
title: runs: task propose wait outlasts Claude Code
